summary: Implemented the Decathalon datalist loader. Changes: (1) monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py (new) with load_decathalon_datalist and private helper _resolve_path, following the ten-step workflow and raising ValueError for all failures; (2) explicit export in monai/data/__init__.py; (3) "Decathalon DataLoader" tilde-underlined subsection with autofunction entry in docs/source/data.rst after the Utilities automodule; (4) tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with class TestLoadDecathalonDatalist and the four specified tests, using addCleanup for temp-dir removal. Choices beyond the spec: a non-list value under the data key raises ValueError, and a non-dict top-level JSON is treated as a missing key. Not verified: tests and black were not run per instructions; line lengths were measured (max 117 columns) and one raise statement was reflowed to match black's join. Nothing was committed.
